segments.thag2.2:1.3: Āhāraṭṭhitiko samussayo, iti disvāna carāmi esanaṃ.
segments.thag2.2:2.1: “Paṅkoti hi naṃ pavedayuṃ, yāyaṃ vandanapūjanā kulesu;
segments.thag2.2:2.3: Sukhumaṃ sallaṃ durubbahaṃ, sakkāro kāpurisena dujjaho”ti.
segments.thag2.2:2.5: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā piṇḍolabhāradvājo thero gāthāyo abhāsitthāti.
